preservedResponsibilities: Original public uno::Environment resolved-pointer/default/copy/move ownership, pointer/copy/move assignment, destruction, clear/get/is and owned getTypeName/borrowed getContext accessors. Actual C environment callbacks and OUString owners are reused. Pointer/copy assignment skips identical pointers; differing pointers acquire new before releasing old and publishing. Clear releases before null publication; self-move releases and clears. Type-name returns own exact Unicode/NUL descriptor references, while context is passed through without address synthesis or identity conversion. Whole original environment.hxx plus unchanged lbenv.cxx and real DefaultEnvironment callbacks supply complete normal-ASan/UBSan identical ownership/accessor streams. Enclosing input records are not production environment constructors/providers. Descriptor/current lookup, invoke/enter/isValid purpose-stack APIs, public bootstrap/application installation, physical ABI/allocator/concurrency/noexcept termination/leaks and full upstream consumer QA remain incomplete or unverified.
omittedResponsibilities: Descriptor/current environment lookup, invocation/purpose stack and validity wrappers; actual environment factory/binding bootstrap, physical pointer/ABI/allocator/concurrency/noexcept termination/leaks and full upstream consumers.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original include/uno/environment.h C records and include/uno/environment.hxx public inline C++ wrapper have the same normalized stem and distinct ownership. The existing environment.ts represents environment.h. Keeping the original .hxx discriminator before .ts preserves their separate ESM module identities and source responsibilities.
